result.description: A fictional 27-inch digital art monitor designed for color-critical sketching, note-taking, and annotation workflows. It features a matte IPS panel, stylus-hover detection overlay, 2560x1440 resolution, USB-C display input, and a built-in ambient light sensor for adaptive white balance. The Aurora Quill 27Q is intended for illustrators, editors, and classroom presenters who want a paper-like viewing surface with low-glare output and reliable color calibration.
result.title: Aurora Quill 27Q Ink Display
